name: open-code-review
description: Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
one_liner: A tool that automatically reads your team's code changes and leaves detailed comments pointing out bugs and security holes, the way a senior reviewer would.
buyer: An engineering manager at a mid-size software shop who wants consistent code reviews without hiring more senior reviewers.
business_use_cases: A dev agency wires it into every client's pull-request pipeline so junior developers' code gets caught before a human reviewer wastes time on it.
A fintech or healthcare startup uses its built-in SQL-injection/XSS ruleset as an automated security gate before code can merge.
A code-review-as-a-service consultancy resells it, white-labeled, to smaller dev shops that can't afford a senior reviewer on staff.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a managed/hosted version with dashboards and org-wide policy enforcement
Charge per-repo or per-seat pricing for teams who don't want to self-host

steal_this: Stand up a hosted instance this weekend, connect it to a few open-source repos' PRs for free, and use the visible before/after review quality as a lead magnet for a paid managed offering.
